title: Client-side Admin Authentication Bypass
description: Admin authentication relies entirely on a client-side passcode check and sessionStorage.
exploit_path: An attacker opens browser DevTools and runs sessionStorage.setItem('zyntral_admin_authed', 'true') to bypass the login screen completely.
user_impact: Complete compromise of the admin portal.
root_cause: Security controls enforced on the client side instead of the server.
fix: Implement Convex Auth or move the passcode verification to a Convex mutation.
verify: Attempt to access /admin with the sessionStorage flag without a valid backend session.

title: Missing Backend Authorization Checks
description: Admin mutations appear to lack authorization checks at the Convex backend level.
exploit_path: An attacker directly calls the Convex API endpoint using the publicly exposed Convex URL.
user_impact: Total data loss or unauthorized data modification.
root_cause: Missing auth.getUserIdentity() or role-based checks in Convex mutations.
fix: Add identity verification to all mutating Convex functions.
verify: Call an admin mutation from an unauthenticated client context.

title: Swallowed Errors in Admin Actions
description: Backend mutation errors are caught and swallowed with generic messages.
user_impact: Users experience silent or generic failures.
root_cause: Catch blocks do not log or report the err object.
fix: Integrate an error tracking service and display actionable error messages.
verify: Force a network failure during a mutation.

title: React Immutability Violation
description: Variable accumulatedAngle is reassigned after render completes.
root_cause: Mutating a local variable instead of using React state.
fix: Refactor to use React state or calculate the value purely during the render cycle.
verify: Check the component rendering in strict mode.

title: Extensive Use of any Type
description: Over 80 instances of any type usage.
fix: Replace any with proper TypeScript interfaces.
